answer: Every claim climbs the jetty of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the gale re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on time-locked work history, re-queued for a second panel, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the vault of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
